desc:
⬜ There’s something satisfying about pressing the keys... Here, every press fills in part of a picture!

Each key is a colored pixel. Pick an image, load it onto your keyboard, and press the keys color by color as your artwork comes to life!

🎧 Satisfying ASMR key clicks
⬜ Every key is part of the picture
🖼️ Choose from tons of images
🌈 Follow the numbers and press
👥 Paint together with friends
✨ Share finished art in the global gallery

👍 Like the game if you enjoy it!

What will your first keyboard masterpiece be? ✨

Inspired by Paint an Album & Paint Anything
Tags: Keyboard Painting, Keyboard Painting by Numbers, Keyboard by Numbers
